description: Answers 'how do we get in front of 3,300+ CEE engineering leaders, and what does it cost?' Builds a cart from ELC's ten published one-off reach items — an ELC meetup, a speaker sprint, a conference main-stage talk, dedicated newsletter, newsletter section, decision-maker dinner, podcast episode, your name on three meetup evenings, community survey, job listing — applies the published combo discount, and returns a decision-ready quote a human can sign.

budget_eur.description: Optional: what you have to spend. Does not change any price — the quote will say whether the cart fits and what to drop if it does not.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."

oneoff_ids.description: Required. Which one-off reach items to quote. One or more of: meetup-hosted, speaker-development, conference-main-stage, newsletter-dedicated, newsletter-section, dinner, podcast-episode, meetup-presence, survey, job-listing. Combo discount applies automatically.
